result.instructions: Tools for EasyPost, hosted by usefulapi.io. Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes EasyPost data. Free plan: 100 tool calls per month. Run easypost_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run easypost_request_feature to record the request. Pro (unlimited calls, $9/month or $90/year): when the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run easypost_upgrade; it returns a Stripe Checkout link for the user to open. easypost_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: easypost_list_shipments
tools.title: List shipments
tools.description: List shipments on the account, most recent first, with pagination and optional filters. API: GET /shipments.

before_id.description: Return records created before this shipment id.

after_id.description: Return records created after this shipment id.

purchased.description: Filter to only purchased (true) or unpurchased (false) shipments.

tools.name: easypost_get_shipment
tools.title: Get a shipment
tools.description: Retrieve a single shipment by id, including its available rates, tracking_code, and postage_label (if purchased). API: GET /shipments/{id}.

tools.name: easypost_list_trackers
tools.title: List trackers
tools.description: List package trackers, optionally filtered by tracking_code or carrier. API: GET /trackers.

carrier.description: Filter by carrier name, e.g. USPS, UPS, FedEx.

tools.name: easypost_get_tracker
tools.title: Get a tracker
tools.description: Retrieve a single tracker by id, including current status and tracking_details history. API: GET /trackers/{id}.

tools.name: easypost_list_addresses
tools.title: List addresses
tools.description: List saved addresses on the account, with pagination. API: GET /addresses.

before_id.description: Return records created before this address id.

after_id.description: Return records created after this address id.

tools.name: easypost_get_address
tools.title: Get an address
tools.description: Retrieve a single address by id, including verification details. API: GET /addresses/{id}.

tools.name: easypost_verify_address
tools.title: Verify an address
tools.description: Create and verify a US or international address, returning deliverability and normalized/corrected fields. No charge. API: POST /addresses (body { address, verify: ["delivery"] }).

tools.name: easypost_create_shipment
tools.title: Create a shipment (get rates)
tools.description: Create a shipment from a to_address, from_address, and parcel, returning the available RATES from all enabled carriers. This only RATES the shipment — it does NOT purchase a label and does NOT charge the account; buying is a separate step (easypost_buy_shipment). API: POST /shipments (body { shipment }).

predefined_package.description: carrier predefined package name, e.g. FlatRateEnvelope

reference.description: Your internal reference string for the shipment.

carrier_accounts.description: Restrict rating to these carrier_account ids.

tools.name: easypost_create_tracker
tools.title: Create a tracker
tools.description: Start tracking a package by its carrier tracking code. Returns the tracker with current status. No charge. API: POST /trackers (body { tracker }).

tracking_code.description: The carrier tracking code to track.

carrier.description: Carrier name, e.g. USPS, UPS, FedEx (helps disambiguate).

tools.name: easypost_buy_shipment
tools.title: Buy a shipping label
tools.description: PURCHASE a shipping label for a shipment at a chosen rate. WARNING: this CHARGES the EasyPost account balance and is irreversible except by requesting a refund (easypost_refund_shipment). Pick a rate_id from the rates returned by easypost_create_shipment or easypost_get_shipment. API: POST /shipments/{id}/buy (body { rate: { id }, insurance? }).

shipment_id.description: Shipment id to buy, e.g. shp_...

rate_id.description: Rate id to purchase (from create_shipment / get_shipment rates).

insurance.description: Dollar amount to insure the shipment for, e.g. "249.99".

tools.name: easypost_refund_shipment
tools.title: Refund / void a label
tools.description: Request a refund (void) of a purchased shipping label. WARNING: reverses a purchase; approval depends on the carrier and label age. API: POST /shipments/{id}/refund.

id.description: Shipment id to refund, e.g. shp_...
